title: fix(components): header-bar merges the authored className onto its root (objectui#10397)
body:
Fixes #10397

## What changed

### Round 1 (`3034937f7` · `acc34b4ce` · `073c75882`)

- `packages/components/src/renderers/navigation/header-bar.tsx`: the root `header` element's classes are now `cn(HEADER_BAR_CLASS, schema.className)`. The renderer's own chrome classes come first and the authored `className` last, merged by tailwind-merge, so an authored utility that conflicts with a default replaces it. Before this, the root was a fixed string, and an authored `className` rendered byte-identical to its absence (the card's probe).
- `content/docs/components/navigation/header-bar.mdx`:
  - A new **Styling** section: the JSON config first, then how `className` merges, including the per-variant conflict rule.
  - The Schema block gains `search`, `actions` and `rightContent` with their declared types. All three are declared on `HeaderBarSchema` at head and read by the renderer.
  - The "fixed height of 64px (`h-16`)" usage note and the retired-`height` migration line now match the code (`h-14`, and `sm:h-16` from `sm` up), and point at `className`.
- `.changeset/10397-header-bar-classname.md`: a new changeset.
- `.changeset/10387-header-bar-unread-keys-retired.md` is objectui#10387's pending changeset. This PR corrects the two body sentences it made false. The frontmatter is byte-identical.
  1. "the `header-bar` renderer reads only `actions`, `crumbs`, `rightContent` and `search`" is now scoped to the keys `HeaderBarSchema` declares for itself.
  2. The `height` migration line said "The header's height is fixed by the renderer". It now says to set the height with `className`.
- A new pin, `packages/components/src/__tests__/header-bar-classname-10397.test.tsx`, which runs through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry.

### Round 2 (`f8662fc11`), per the seat's claim amendment (comment 5826860702)

- `packages/types/src/zod/navigation.zod.ts`: the nine `header-bar` tombstone refusals (`title`, `logo`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky`, `height`, `variant`) said the renderer "reads only `actions`, `crumbs`, `rightContent` and `search` off the node". They now say it reads those "and the inherited `className`". The `height` refusal said "The height is fixed by the renderer". It now says to author `className` to change the height, merged after the default `h-14` / `sm:h-16`. Only the text changes: the same keys are refused with the same `invalid_type` code and path, and the types suite is green.
- `packages/types/src/navigation.ts`: the matching `@deprecated` docs (`title`, `nav`, `left`, `height`, `variant`) are corrected the same way.
  - **Beyond the literal amendment:** the `body` and `children` tombstone docs on the same interface listed "What the renderer DOES read off this node: `actions`, `crumbs`, `rightContent`, `search`". That list is now false too. It now includes `className`, marked "since objectui#10397". That is the convention the same family uses on `breadcrumb`, `pagination` and `navigation-menu`, which list `className`. Same file, same falsified sentence; named here so the seat can reject it.
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`: `ui:header-bar` moves to the default `COMPONENTS_READY` selector, and its `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS` entry is dropped. The docblock reading, the "why each of the N targets" sentence and `DOCBLOCK_COUNTS` go from 155 matched / four overrides to 156 / three. An issue-stamped note records why the entry left.
- `.changeset/10397-header-bar-classname.md` now declares `'@object-ui/components': patch` and `'@object-ui/types': patch`. Its body gains a sentence naming the refusal-text correction.
- Pins on the exact refusal text: none exist. `header-bar-unread-keys-10387` and `mirror-groups-cd-10286` assert only the `REFUSED (objectui#…, ADR-0049)` prefix and the four read keys in backticks, and both still hold. No case was changed or deleted.
- The pending objectui#10387 and objectui#10286 changesets were re-read against the new refusal text; every sentence still holds, so neither is edited this round.

## PM mechanism assumptions, as measured (round 1)

- **A1 holds: nothing else passed a className to this root.**
  - The registered function took `({ schema })` only. No registry wrapper touches className.
  - `SchemaRenderer` hands a component the node's className twice, on `schema` and as the `className` prop, with the same value, its `responsiveStyles` scope class included. So `schema.className` is the one channel read (the seat ruled Q2: A). The one path where the two channels differ is a host passing `className` to `SchemaRenderer` itself (its props-last spread replaces the prop, not `schema.className`), so there the host class is not read. No in-tree host renders `header-bar` that way; if one ever needs it, the fix belongs in `SchemaRenderer`.
  - Reading both would print a non-Tailwind class twice. Measured: tailwind-merge keeps `x x`.
- **A2: other `BaseSchema` channels are still ignored.** `style`, `id`, `testId`, `ariaLabel` and `data-obj-*` still leave the root unchanged. Not fixed here; the seat files it.
- **A3: the docs example is valid.** No gate type-checks this page's fences. The new `json` example passes the published zod `HeaderBarSchema.safeParse`, with a retired-key control that fails.

## Reverse proofs

- **Round 1, the pin** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - Removing the `schema.className` merge gave `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)` at `073c75882`: every override row red, the harness and the no-`className` control green.
  - Reading both channels turned exactly the "appears ONCE" row and the exact class-list row red.
- **Round 2, the sweep move, measured two ways at `f8662fc11`:**
  1. With the sweep move in place, removing the renderer's merge beneath it gives `Tests 1 failed | 229 passed (230)`. Exactly the `ui:header-bar` row goes red, on "readiness selector `.zzready-canary` never matched". So the move rests on the repair and on nothing else.
  2. Reverting only the move (the selector back to `header.border-b`) gives `3 failed | 227 passed`. The `ui:header-bar` readiness row stays green, and the two-way reason row plus the `componentsReadyMatched` / `componentsReadyOverrides` count rows go red. The bookkeeping would not let the move be undone silently.

## Verification

- **Round 1, at `073c75882`:**
  - The `@object-ui/components` closure build and `type-check` both exited 0.
  - 18 targeted suites passed (`Tests 1909 passed`).
  - Gates exited 0: changeset presence, no-major, fixed, claims, overwrite and pending literals; `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); `check:control-bytes`; the five docs gates; `check:icon-record-names`; `check-test-path-roots`; and the three `check-vi-mock-*` gates.
  - Lint on the two touched files: 0 errors, and 1 warning the base file already had.
  - `check-doc-snippet-types` was NOT MEASURED (it needs 34 packages built), but the page carries no ts/tsx fence.
- **Round 2, at `f8662fc11`:**
  - The `@object-ui/app-shell` closure, `@object-ui/types` included: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` completed 28/28 tasks. The rebuilt `dist` carries the new refusal text.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` both exited 0.
  - One vitest run over the whole `packages/types/` suite, `widget-dom-leak-sweep` and the four components `header-bar` suites: `Test Files 235 passed (235)`, `Tests 5507 passed (5507)`.
  - Gates each exited 0: `check-changeset-presence` ("5 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:control-bytes`.
  - `check:changeset-claims` flagged four pending changesets that name the edited files (6349, 6645, 6646, 7917). I read each paragraph; they describe breadcrumb declarations and the crumb glyph, and all still hold.
  - ESLint on the three touched files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- **Left to CI:** the full test shards and repo-wide lint.

## Acceptance notes

- **`responsiveStyles` now reach the root.** A node's `responsiveStyles` scope class rides `className`, so it now reaches the root too. This is pinned and stated in the changeset.
- **Conflicts resolve per variant.** `h-20` replaces `h-14` but leaves `sm:h-16`. The docs say so, and the pin asserts both halves.
- **`search` is documented by what it renders.** The renderer attaches no handler to the input and binds no key for `shortcut`.
- **Filed by the seat at ACCEPT, not changed here:**
  - The root still drops the other injected props (`style`, `id`, `ariaLabel`, `testId`, `data-obj-*`).
  - The sweep's two-way override assertion does not catch a reason whose target no longer needs one. Before round 2 the suite was green with the stale `ui:header-bar` entry.
